title: the whole, and a page for each place ({count})
query: SELECT path, looks, scale, of_thing, says FROM (SELECT 'index.html' AS path, 'fulldome' AS looks, 'every place observed' AS scale, '' AS of_thing, 'the whole: every lens, over every place in view' AS says UNION ALL SELECT 'places/' || place || '.html', 'around@' || id, star, id, coalesce(says, '') FROM things WHERE of_table = 'places') ORDER BY path

title: a page for each sign ({count})
query: SELECT 'signs/' || place || '/' || substr(id, length(place) + length(of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || id AS looks, star || ', a sign' AS scale, id AS of_thing, star, coalesce(says, '') AS says FROM things WHERE of_table = 'problems' ORDER BY path

title: a page for each angle of the perfect form ({count})
query: SELECT 'form/' || substr(id, length(place) + length(of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || id AS looks, 'the perfect form' AS scale, id AS of_thing, coalesce(says, '') AS says FROM things WHERE of_table = 'idea' AND star = 'ecosystem' ORDER BY path

title: a page for each decision a sign came to ({count})
query: SELECT 'decisions/' || t.place || '/' || substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || t.id AS looks, t.star || ', a decision' AS scale, t.id AS of_thing, t.star, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says FROM things t WHERE t.of_table = 'decisions' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e."to" = t.id AND e.from_table = 'problems') ORDER BY path
